finding.title: Unauthenticated RCE via JNDI lookup in logging library
finding.description: A remote, unauthenticated attacker who can get a crafted string logged causes the JNDI feature to fetch and execute arbitrary code from an attacker-controlled LDAP server, resulting in remote code execution on the host.

finding.title: Remote memory disclosure via TLS heartbeat over-read
finding.description: A remote unauthenticated attacker sends crafted heartbeat packets that trigger a buffer over-read, leaking sensitive information from process memory. No integrity or availability impact.
finding.evidence: Malformed TLS heartbeat returns 64KB of adjacent memory.

finding.title: Pre-auth RCE in Remote Desktop Services
finding.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker connects over RDP and sends specially crafted requests achieving remote code execution with full impact to confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
finding.evidence: Crafted RDP channel request triggers use-after-free and code execution.

finding.title: Local privilege escalation to root via SUID helper
finding.description: Any local user can exploit a memory corruption in a SUID helper to execute arbitrary code as root, fully compromising the host.
finding.evidence: Local CLI exploit yields a root shell.

finding.title: Reflected cross-site scripting in search parameter
finding.description: The q parameter is reflected unsanitized. A victim who clicks a crafted link executes attacker JavaScript in their session, a cross-site scripting issue that crosses into the browser security context.

finding.title: Unauthenticated SQL injection in login endpoint
finding.description: A remote unauthenticated attacker injects SQL via the username field on the public login API, allowing full read and write of the database.
finding.evidence: POST /api/login username=' OR 1=1-- returns full user table.

finding.title: Remote unauthenticated denial of service via malformed packet
finding.description: A remote unauthenticated attacker sends a malformed packet that crashes the service, causing a denial of service with no confidentiality or integrity impact.
finding.evidence: Single crafted UDP packet reliably crashes the daemon.

finding.title: IDOR exposes other users' records
finding.description: An authenticated low-privilege user can read other users' sensitive records by changing an object id, an insecure direct object reference and information disclosure. No modification is possible.
finding.evidence: GET /api/records/{id} returns records belonging to other accounts.

finding.title: Authenticated command injection in admin settings
finding.description: An authenticated administrator can inject operating system commands via a settings field, achieving arbitrary code execution on the server with full impact.

finding.title: Adjacent-network man-in-the-middle via downgrade
finding.description: An attacker on the same network segment can, under a specific configuration and with high complexity, perform a man-in-the-middle downgrade to read and modify traffic. Availability is unaffected.
finding.evidence: MITM on the local LAN segment forces a protocol downgrade.
